title: A sequence of C^1 radial cutoffs with shrinking transition width
statement: There exist functions phi_k : R -> R (k in N) and real numbers eps_k (k in N) such that: (a) 0 < eps_k <= 1 for every k; (b) eps_k -> 0 as k -> infinity; (c) every phi_k is C^1; (d) every phi_k is nonincreasing; (e) 0 <= phi_k(u) <= 1 for all k and u; (f) phi_k(u) = 1 whenever u <= 1; (g) phi_k(u) = 0 whenever u >= 1 + eps_k.
lean_statement: ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 < ε k ∧ ε k ≤ 1) ∧ Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k, Antitone (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k u, 0 ≤ φ k u ∧ φ k u ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k u, u ≤ 1 → φ k u = 1) ∧ (∀ k u, 1 + ε k ≤ u → φ k u = 0)
